theme_and_archetype.rationale: For a 3D printing and AI generator app, the interface needs to feel like a high-end, precision maker tool (like a dark mode slicer). We avoid 'AI magic' purples and instead use deep obsidian, blueprint blues, and alert oranges.

typography.heading: Outfit
typography.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Always use JetBrains Mono for G-code, slicer settings values, mesh stats, and dimensions to emphasize the technical nature of the app.

colors.rules: Avoid gradients unless simulating lighting on 3D objects. Rely on 1px solid borders and high-contrast text. Strictly no purple/violet AI-slop colors.

layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky bottom tab bar with glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10) for one-handed use.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Control Room Grid for Slicer Settings (dense, data-rich). Bento Grid for the Library/Gallery.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Generous spacing (p-4 to p-6) for main screens, but dense (p-2 to p-3) for slicer inputs to fit everything on screen.

components_instructions.cards: Use flat solid background (#18181B) with 1px border (#27272A). No soft drop shadows. Sharp and tactile.
components_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons use #2563EB background with white text. High contrast hover states. Include data-testid on all buttons.
components_instructions.3d_viewer: Should be a full-bleed view where possible. Overlaid data (mesh info, triangle count, print time) should use 'Crystal Glass' floating panels (backdrop-blur-md bg-black/40 border-white/10).
components_instructions.forms_inputs: Shadcn Input, Select, and Slider for slicer settings. Thumb-friendly sliders are crucial for layer height and infill. Values should be displayed in JetBrains Mono.
components_instructions.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for Gallery (Images, Videos, 3D Models) and Slicer modes. Custom styling to remove bubble look; use sharp underlines or solid block highlights.
components_instructions.bottom_sheet: Use Shadcn Dialog/Drawer to pull up Slicer Settings from the bottom, keeping the 3D model visible in the background.

motion_and_interaction.transitions: Mechanical and snappy. Avoid long, floaty animations.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Hover/active states must increase brightness and optionally add a 1px primary color border.
motion_and_interaction.haptics: Assume haptic feedback on mobile for sliders and slice generation.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Maintain strictly WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case and role-based format (e.g., data-testid='generate-3d-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first PWA or responsive web app UI representing 'ForgeAI'.
Ensure a bottom navigation bar for mobile views containing Dashboard, Generate, Gallery, Profile.
Implement Shadcn UI for forms, sliders (slicer settings), tabs, and dialogs.
For the 3D Viewer screen, use a mockup container if Three.js/R3F is unavailable, but layer glassmorphic UI panels (dimensions, mesh count) over it to show the spatial UX pattern.
Use JetBrains Mono for any technical metrics, slice times, G-code snippets, or layer heights.
Do NOT use gradients on backgrounds; stick to the solid #09090B and #18181B theme. Apply 1px #27272A borders aggressively to delineate sections (Grid Borders look).
Gallery should separate Images, Videos, and 3D Models with clear tab navigation.
MUST include 'data-testid' on ALL inputs, buttons, tab triggers, and generation controls.
